items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Her name was Elizabeth Helen Hamilton, Helen Henry.

ctx.x: So you had to have automatic separation there because I know they weren’t letting privates go as any kind of accompanied tour. So you got married, then you got sent to McLellan. Can we get your wife’s name on tape? Go ahead and get that stated. Her maiden name was what?
Her name was Elizabeth Helen Hamilton, Helen Henry.
